description: This file defines classes related to monitoring dimensions within the Orleans streaming infrastructure, including receiver monitor dimensions, cache monitor dimensions, and block pool monitor dimensions.

classes.name: ReceiverMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Represents aggregation dimensions for a receiver monitor, identified by a queue ID.

classes.name: CacheMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Extends ReceiverMonitorDimensions to include a block pool ID, representing cache-specific monitoring dimensions.

classes.name: BlockPoolMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Represents dimensions for a block pool monitor, identified by a block pool ID.

methods.name: ReceiverMonitorDimensions
methods.description: Constructor initializing ReceiverMonitorDimensions with a specific queue ID.

methods.name: CacheMonitorDimensions
methods.description: Constructor initializing CacheMonitorDimensions with queue ID and block pool ID.

methods.name: BlockPoolMonitorDimensions
methods.description: Constructor initializing BlockPoolMonitorDimensions with a block pool ID.
